violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM OBSERVED ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF OBTAIN A CFM CERTIFICATION AND THAT A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE ESTABLISHMENT AT 62-65F DURING THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC UNDERSTANDS THE HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC REMOVED SPLITTER DURING INSPECTION AND WILL SEND EHS INVOICE FOR APPROVED SPLITTER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
